candidate.professional_summary: Network support professional with 8+ years of experience in networking, Cisco routing and switching, network monitoring, troubleshooting, and WAN operations. Experienced with Cisco, Juniper, data communication protocols, wireless networks, MPLS, and large-scale production and corporate network infrastructure.

education.source_text: B.S: Internet Technology, Bloomfield College; GPA 3.5
Graduate Certification in Wireless Network Management

experience.title: Network Support Engineer
responsibilities: Supported a 24x7 data network center and monitored network performance.
Managed and maintained Cisco IOS, IOS-XR, and JunOS hardware.
Analyzed complex network and routing issues involving Cisco and Juniper equipment.
Troubleshot routing issues, trunk failures, hardware failures, software failures, and network links.
Supported Layer 2 and Layer 3 platforms, including ATM, Frame Relay, BGP, and OSPF.
Installed, configured, and supported routers, switches, console servers, and optical transport equipment.
Created Cisco and Juniper support cases and performed RMA procedures.
Provided consultation and training to new employees.
achievements: Provided outage analysis and resolution for network and customer problems.
experience.source_text: Supported 24x7 data network center; managed Cisco IOS, IOS-XR and JunOS hardware; troubleshot routing, trunk, hardware and software failures.

experience.title: Contractor
responsibilities: Provided Tier-3 support for Verizon Wireless customers and business users.
Analyzed and resolved customer-impacting faults in the Verizon Wireless network.
Troubleshot roaming, transport services, network hardware and software faults, translations, and voice/data network elements.
Worked with NOC, system performance, and RF engineering teams on escalated issues.
Used ticketing and network monitoring tools to investigate incidents.
achievements: Supported isolation and resolution of wireless voice and data faults affecting service.
experience.source_text: Provided Tier-3 support for Verizon Wireless customers and resolved service-impacting wireless voice and data faults.

experience.title: Network Support
responsibilities: Monitored the network and provided IT and basic system-level support to medical offices.
Provided network support for equipment and infrastructure installations and provisioning.
Managed outages, network trouble tickets, vendors, and local/global telecommunications providers.
Monitored customer uptime and network quality and communicated status to customers and internal teams.
Defined hardware and system configurations and recommendations for projects.
Troubleshot Cisco switch duplex mismatches and checked bandwidth usage.
Detected failures using HSRP and performed CE failover when needed.
Documented trouble resolution and assisted with training.
experience.source_text: Monitored the network, supported installations and provisioning, handled outages and trouble tickets, and used HSRP for failure detection and CE failover.

experience.title: IP Support Engineer
responsibilities: Participated in 24x7 incidents in a Level 2 NOC/GSC environment.
Supported and maintained WAN network operations for more than 25,000 customers under strict SLAs.
Performed circuit break-fix and Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3 support.
Called out outages to telecommunications providers and managed network trouble tickets.
Used BGP and ping to assess remote-site connectivity and latency.
Supported circuit provisioning, testing, and turn-up during service delivery.
Troubleshot customer line issues, routing issues, and migrations across global MPLS networks.
Monitored client connectivity over Frame Relay, private line, DS1, DS3, E1, and E3 connections.
Performed loop, BERT, and link testing to isolate network issues.
Coordinated equipment repairs, replacements, dispatches, vendors, and telecommunications providers.
Tracked and maintained inventory of defective and replacement parts.
Owned issues through resolution and task closure.
achievements: Supported WAN operations for over 25,000 customers.
Maintained a mean time to resolution of 2–8 hours for customer troubles.
experience.source_text: Supported WAN operations for over 25,000 customers, including circuit break-fix, BGP/MPLS troubleshooting, circuit provisioning, and global network issue isolation.

experience.title: Deployment Technician
responsibilities: Contracted through CompuCom to roll out approximately 1,500 computers.
Scanned user computers, desktops, laptops, network drives, and mail for legal data requirements.
Updated network and shared-drive data and assisted the project manager.
Administered user-defined configurations.
Backed up and restored user data.
Troubleshot data transfer, software, hardware, and network issues.
Answered client concerns about network-related problems.
achievements: Participated in a rollout of approximately 1,500 computers.
experience.source_text: Contracted through CompuCom at Pfizer to roll out about 1,500 computers and troubleshoot data, software, hardware, and network issues.
